## What each tier costs

Pricing below is pulled from the live Superhuman Docs plan page, which is where coda.io/pricing now resolves, as of September 2026.

| Tier | Price (billed annually) | Price (billed monthly) | Who it's for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | $0 | Individuals or small teams testing the product |
| Pro | $12/Doc Maker/month | $15/Doc Maker/month | Small to mid-sized teams needing unlimited doc size and AI features |
| Business | $33/Doc Maker/month | $40/Doc Maker/month | Teams needing unlimited automations, private folders, and doc locking |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Orgs needing SSO, SCIM provisioning, audit events, and compliance reports |
